institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Fludarabine/cyclophosphamide lymphodepletion (before CD19 CAR-T)

premedications.name: Tumor-lysis prophylaxis
premedications.notes: hydration + allopurinol if residual bulky disease

supportiveCare: Antimicrobial prophylaxis (antibacterial, antiviral, antifungal, PJP) through the lymphopenic period
Given as conditioning immediately before CAR T-cell infusion, not as ongoing therapy
monitoring: CBC (deliberately induces lymphodepletion to support CAR T-cell expansion)
Renal function (fludarabine is renally cleared - reduce for impaired clearance)

drugs.name: Fludarabine
drugs.notes: 30 mg/m2 IV daily for 3 days (conventionally days -5 to -3 before cell infusion). Reduce for renal impairment.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: 500 mg/m2 IV daily for 3 days, concurrent with fludarabine.
